column3: a captain stop is a machine flag every automation reads before starting anything
spawns refuse while a stop flag exists, before argument validation
the day-close lift can never remove a captain-origin stop
a captain word becomes a typed durable record at the moment of receipt
a decision or prohibition closes only with the captain's verbatim words
a decided subject blocks resubmission without a named new fact
every session start pins active orders and demands recitation before acting
unchanged context files compact to one line; changes print in full; re-anchor always prints full
the dead-man judges liveness from the lock pid and the process tree, never from window labels
revival touches only the leadership window and never wakes workers or officers
the day close stops softly, reports honestly, and reboots only armed and undeferred
from the pre-warning zone on, no new launches start that evening
a day-close finding keeps the stop and warns the captain instead of lifting
daily lessons stay hypothesis-stage candidates; the ledger is never auto-written
judging is marked not decision-capable while no frozen captain gold set exists
deployed state is measured against the repo on cadence, at the target, never from memory
a service-repo merge deposits an owed rollout that only a confirmed deploy clears
a failed probe is reported as failed and never read as in sync
the captain register renders from the backlog, keyed per line, never hand-fed
the ten-per-area cap is enforced by the machine with a disclosed overflow row
the hand-kept register is never overwritten without explicit takeover plus archive
the content wake rule has exactly one owner shared by signal triage and the heartbeat backstop
parent-chain climbing has exactly one mechanical owner
queued wakes stay durable until a drain presents them, and an open decision resurfaces on every drain until answered
open captain calls resurface from the durable status fold, not from memory
unread status lines are presented once and never silently dropped
teardown refuses while uncommitted or unlanded work exists
every task merge runs through the recording merge path with its guards
steering sends verify delivery; unconfirmed is a distinct verdict, not success
project work starts in an isolated worktree, never the primary checkout
every number carries measured/derived/estimated provenance
